title: V5 Benchmark Task Manifest
description: Authoritative record for one benchmark task, grounded in UBERBOND_FABLE_FRACTION_STRATEGY_V5.zip / 13_BENCHMARK_TASK_BANK.md and 14_BENCHMARK_MANIFEST.csv. One file per task under manifests/.

task_id.description: Immutable task ID, e.g. CAL-UB-01. Never renumbered.

capability_class.description: One of the four bank capability classes, e.g. evidence-quality:narrow-repair.

of.description: What was hashed, e.g. '13_BENCHMARK_TASK_BANK.md section for this task_id' or a source-file list.

mode.description: CALIBRATION tasks are VISIBLE_CALIBRATION (answer/tests may be in-repo). HELD_OUT/ADVERSARIAL must be SEALED_PLACEHOLDER: no hidden answer, fixture mutation, or hidden test may be committed to this repository.

vault_pointer.description: Non-resolving pointer string naming the future private-vault path this task's hidden material must live in, per CONTAMINATION_POLICY.md storage topology. Never a real, reachable location inside this repository.

required_future_evidence.description: What the vault custodian must supply before this task can be scored: fixture mutation, answer key, hidden tests, canary. Required when sealed=true.

scoring_rubric.description: The task-specific binding of the common 100-point frame (35/20/15/10/8/7/5).

hidden_evaluator_checks.description: For CALIBRATION tasks only: disclosed hidden-evaluator check descriptions (from the visible bank). Must be empty for HELD_OUT/ADVERSARIAL manifests.

cleanup_contract.description: Exact cleanup/rollback procedure text from the task bank.
